channel.title: The Lawrence Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Lawrence Times (lawrencekstimes.com)

item.title: Lawrence school district names next Sunset Hill Elementary principal
item.description: The Lawrence school board on Monday approved hiring Courtney Ellis as the next principal of Sunset Hill Elementary School.

item.title: Lawrence superintendent to seek feedback at community meetings this winter
item.description: The Lawrence school district superintendent will soon host a series of meetings to elicit feedback from students, staff, families and the local community.

item.title: Upcoming Watkins Museum exhibition to celebrate 5 decades of KU’s Hall Center for the Humanities
item.description: An upcoming exhibition at the Watkins Museum will look at 50 years of growth and impact at the Hall Center for the Humanities, a research center at KU.

item.title: Kansas Supreme Court chief justice pleads for investments in specialty courts, rural attorneys
item.description: Kansas Supreme Court Chief Justice Eric Rosen pressed the Legislature on Tuesday to expand funding for specialty courts and asked lawmakers to collaborate on solutions to the shortage of attorneys in rural Kansas.

item.title: Man killed at Lawrence City Hall had schizophrenia, was stranded during trip, his sister says
item.description: The Minnesota man shot and killed in Lawrence City Hall last week had schizophrenia and was distressed after being stranded en route to his grandmother, according to his friend and his sister.

item.title: Kansas governor revels in triumphs, warns against succumbing to ‘uncivilized’ D.C. politics
item.description: Gov. Laura Kelly said during her State of the State speech that Kansas would have suffered in managing the government, advancing economic activity and elevating the quality of life if voters had chosen a governor who confused toxicity for leadership.

item.title: Kansas House Speaker touts Republican supermajority’s ‘people-first agenda’
item.description: Kansas House Speaker Dan Hawkins underscored the force of the Republican supermajority and its 2025 policy wins in his response to Democratic Gov. Laura Kelly’s final State of the State address.

item.title: Plans for a family emergency shelter in Lawrence have fallen through
item.description: A shelter for families experiencing homelessness in Lawrence will not come to fruition because of a lack of funding, a city staff member told the Lawrence City Commission Tuesday evening.

item.title: Lawrence City Commission general public comment for Jan. 13, 2026
item.description: Here’s the general public comment for the Lawrence City Commission’s Tuesday meeting, as public comment is no longer being broadcast.

item.title: Lawrence library to host event series on Martin Luther King Jr. Day
item.description: The Lawrence Public Library will celebrate the legacy of Martin Luther King Jr. with a lineup of family-friendly events, free lunch and a food drive.
